title: The planned benchmark output gives sweep-on runs a `SweepPassRecord`, but that type does not include the categ
text: The planned benchmark output gives sweep-on runs a `SweepPassRecord`, but that type does not include the category-list version; the identity block also omits it. AC9 requires the precision evidence to record the category-list version used, so the implementation/evidence steps cannot satisfy it without guessing. Add an explicit list-version field to the sweep-on benchmark and precision records, evidence assembly, and tests.
